config.design: 12 new adjective pairs in three fixed cohorts x4 templates x4 states. Templates film,book,story and changed I-thought review prefix. No outcome-based replacement; model H979 already frozen.
config.gate: At least4 quartets/cohort; >=.75 all-four binary correctness and >=.5 full-vocabulary intended-group top1.
config.novelty: Adjective strings checked against H962/H975 panels; exact prompts checked against H962/H966/H975. No claim of unseen model-training words.
config.capture: Native logits and normalized adjective MLP3 inputs/writes; no fitting, interventions or reserved-test access.
config.semantics: Binary negation reversal is an operational test; not-negative may be neutral.
